hooks.command: FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file_path',''))"); if echo "$FILE" | grep -q '\.env'; then echo 'Blocked: editing .env files requires manual confirmation'; exit 1; fi

CMD=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('command',''))"); case "$CMD" in *'git commit'*) BRANCH=$(git -C "$(pwd)" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ "$BRANCH" = "master" ]; then echo 'Blocked: never commit directly to master. Create a branch first (see CLAUDE.md ## Git Workflow).'; exit 1; fi;; esac

FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file_path',''))"); if [ -n "$FILE" ]; then npx @biomejs/biome check --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true; fi

FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file_path',''))"); case "$FILE" in *.tsx|*.jsx) rustywind --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac
